titulo: Rubio hails Colombia's new pro-Trump leader De la Espriella on first stop of Latin American tour
cuerpo: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio pledged closer security cooperation with Bogota on the first stop of his three-nation tour of pro-Washington Latin American nations. Rubio hailed the election of Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella as part of a growing alignment with US interests across the Western Hemisphere.
